sourceArticle.title: Osaurus brings both local and cloud AI models to your Mac
sourceArticle.author: Sarah Perez

athenaOutput.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine will be the definitive, sovereign platform for orchestrating both local and cloud AI models, providing a seamless, secure, and visually intuitive user experience.
athenaOutput.rationale: The core value proposition of Osaurus, which is to provide a unified interface for managing local and cloud AI models while prioritizing local data and user control, is a fundamental and already established strategic imperative for the Creative Liberation Engine. Our existing constitutional laws, particularly Article I (Sovereignty) and Article IX (Ship Complete or Don't Ship), coupled with prior strategic directives to establish the Creative Liberation Engine as 'the definitive, sovereign platform for unlimited, high-performance local AI coding' and to provide 'robust, sovereign, and visually intuitive local agent observability,' fully encompass the capabilities described by Osaurus. Integrating Osaurus as a separate entity or developing a similar, distinct 'harness' would be redundant and violate our principle of building complete, self-hosted solutions.
constitutionalFlags: Article IX: Ship Complete or Don't Ship
